recipe.script:
#!/usr/bin/env python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""独立复算交付簿：重扫 target、按同一排除口径重算 sha256，得到 content_digest 与清单比对。
用法: python verify_manifest_fixed.py <target_dir> <MANIFEST-fixed.json>
输出: files / digest / manifest_digest / MATCH|MISMATCH（并列出 missing/extra/mismatch 前 20）"""
import hashlib, json, os, sys
root, manpath = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
man = json.load(open(manpath, encoding="utf-8"))

def classify(rel):
    parts = rel.split("/"); name = parts[-1]
    if "__pycache__" in parts: return "pycache"
    if name.endswith(".pyc"): return "pyc"
    if parts[0] == "state": return "state"
    if parts[0] == ".scratch": return "scratch"
    if rel == "MANIFEST.json": return "selfman"
    if rel.startswith("gbt_allinone/store/"): return "store"
    if rel.startswith("gbt_allinone/secrets/"): return "secret"
    if ".git" in parts: return "git"
    return None

cur = {}
for dp, dns, fns in os.walk(root):
    for fn in fns:
        p = os.path.join(dp, fn)
        rel = os.path.relpath(p, root).replace("\\", "/")
        if classify(rel) is not None: continue
        h = hashlib.sha256()
        with open(p, "rb") as f:
            for c in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""): h.update(c)
        cur[rel] = (os.path.getsize(p), h.hexdigest())
canon = "\n".join("%s\0%d\0%s" % (k, v[0], v[1]) for k, v in sorted(cur.items()))
digest = hashlib.sha256(canon.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
w = {f["path"]: f for f in man["files"]}
missing = sorted(set(w) - set(cur)); extra = sorted(set(cur) - set(w))
mism = sorted(k for k in set(w) & set(cur) if (w[k]["size"], w[k]["sha256"]) != cur[k])
print("files:", len(cur), "digest:", digest)
print("manifest_digest:", man["totals"]["content_digest"], "manifest_files:", len(w))
print("missing:", len(missing), missing[:20])
print("extra:", len(extra), extra[:20])
print("mismatch:", len(mism), mism[:20])
print("MATCH" if (digest == man["totals"]["content_digest"] and not missing and not extra and not mism) else "MISMATCH")

exclusions.why: 任何 __pycache__/ 目录：Python 字节码缓存，可由源码重建
state/ 整树：运行时数据（记忆/日志/绑定/锁），非交付源码
MANIFEST.json 自身：清单不登记自己
gbt_allinone/store/ 整树：运行时数据仓
gbt_allinone/secrets/ 整树：凭据，绝不入清单
任何含 .git 的路径：版本库内部
pyembed/ 整树：第三方 embeddable Python 运行时（84MB，可整包替换，非自有源码；2026-11-05 才搬入本仓）
_upstream/ 整树：第三方参考仓（只读，.gitignore 已声明永不进版本历史）
outputs/ 整树：产物与导出（.gitignore 已整目录排除；含 833MB 的 repo-pack 打包件）
*.bak / *.bak-* / *.orig / *.rej：临时备份件（.gitignore 全仓规则；基线里此类条目为 0）
